title: T1000-E: BLE local transport
description: Validate BLE local-client transport on T1000-E nRF52840. Same BLE-class MCU as RAK4631. Test peripheral mode and local client connection.
notes: Hardware validation task. BLE transport code infrastructure exists (CONFIG_LICHEN_BLE_TRANSPORT), but T1000-E lacks BLE board config (no CONFIG_BT in defconfig, no board overlay in ble_ipsp_transport/). Testing peripheral mode and local client connection requires physical T1000-E device with another BLE central device. Prerequisites: (1) add CONFIG_BT settings to t1000_e_nrf52840_defconfig, (2) add t1000_e board overlay to ble_ipsp_transport/boards/, (3) physical device testing.
